description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks at Cap Break Level 1, En-Lightning, En-Lightning Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I to user, Lightning Ability Damage +3% to party
Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Lightning & chases 1/2/3/4+ Lightning abilities with Deadly Strikes +5/10/15/20% to equipped Lightning abilities

description.name: Awoken Electric Rush (Dual Shift)
description.text:
Instant ATB 1 & Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II to user
Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II: Instant Celerity/Support & chases a Celerity/Support ability with D Online Mode
D Online Mode: When an ally uses [Element] ability, grants Quick ATB 1 & [Element] Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to that ally (max 2 chases)
